label: Metamorphic rocks
text: EA.O.A1.4 Metamorphic rocks. Formed by solid-state change. A metamorphic facies (Eskola 1920) is a set of mineral assemblages formed over a stated range of pressure and temperature. Foliation records directed stress. The rock cycle is a path among A1.2–A1.4, not a clock.

warrant.standard: Analytical identification (XRD, microprobe) with stated precision
